responsibility: This machine-description file defines the SPARC backend’s RTL predicates used by sparc.md and sync.md to recognize valid operands and operators. It classifies constants, symbolic and TLS references, addresses, memory forms, comparison operators, and SPARC-specific operand legality rules such as small immediates, sethi-loadable values, PIC forms, and compare/call operands, forming the semantic operand vocabulary for instruction matching and expansion.
